ideas.pitch: A specialized practice environment for blind coding competitions that records keystrokes without rendering video output, analyzing logic and syntax errors post-submission.
ideas.title: BlindCoder Sandbox
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the event's unique Blind Coding challenge format, providing a much-needed training tool for students preparing for the competition.

ideas.pitch: A real-time competitive programming arena featuring automated test-case generation, WebSocket-based synchronization, and live head-to-head performance tracking for DSA battles.
ideas.title: AlgoDuel Live
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the DSA Battle event format by offering judges a seamless platform to manage and visualize live algorithmic showdowns.

ideas.pitch: An educational IDE extension that forces early-year students to practice coding entirely from memory by hiding the editor canvas on a countdown timer.
ideas.title: MemoryTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Engages the first and second-year demographic participating in the blind coding track by gamifying foundational memory and logic retention.

ideas.pitch: An automated DSA problem analyzer that evaluates submitted solutions for time and space complexity bottlenecks using abstract syntax tree parsing.
ideas.title: ComplexityCoach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to the advanced competitive programmers in the DSA Battle track by offering deep, instant algorithmic insights beyond simple pass/fail verdicts.

ideas.pitch: A tournament management system purpose-built for multi-tier coding hackathons, handling real-time leaderboards, blind submissions, and bracket pairings.
ideas.title: ClashBracket
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the logistical overhead of running both Blind Coding and DSA Battle tracks simultaneously under one roof.
